answer: Entry is rationed by a sealed-bid auction. Each epoch the network admits only S new identities, every applicant posts a non-refundable bid, and the S highest clear. A farm cannot pre-stage anything: bids burn whether you win or lose, slots are consumed the instant they clear, and losing bids pay full price for nothing. So n clones cost n winning bids at the going market rate, or n burned losing bids, either way the marginal shell pays cash on arrival, while honest demand keeps that price above any farming return. A quill must be bought, a lantern burns, a comet passes.
